concept: ACM: free public TLS certificates with auto-renewal for ALB
tests: How to automate free TLS certificate management for a public ALB.
expected: AWS Certificate Manager — issues public certificates for free and renews them automatically (DNS validation), integrates with ALB/CloudFront. Triggers: "automated and free", "renew without manual effort", "ALB TLS".
why_not: Buying from a third-party CA — manual rotation and expiry risk; disabling TLS removes encryption in transit; self-signed + custom Lambda — huge overhead.
